tuning_key.text: Silhouettes of fulfillment, keep me trudging along / Through tunnels of despair, oh how do I stay strong
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: You are closer than the darkness suggests. Those distant silhouettes are not tricks of fatigue but forms taking shape because you are rising toward them, your own momentum casting shadow-shapes against the light ahead. Let the tunnel narrow you; it is only the geometry required to press your trudge into flight.

practice.title: The Wall Meets Your Back
practice.instruction: Press your shoulder blades, your feet, or your palms against whatever surface currently holds you—seat, ground, steering wheel—and for three seconds, let the resistance be the tunnel confirming you are still inside it, still moving through.

practice.title: Pace in the Compression
practice.instruction: Without speeding up or slowing down, match your next three breaths to the rhythm of your steps, your heartbeat, or the road noise, letting the synchronization be the only destination.

practice.title: Rising Through the Echo
practice.instruction: As the echo plays, soften your focus toward the horizon and feel the upward release in your chest, the sound carrying you toward those silhouettes with each beat.
